note: Wikimedia Commons flood videos used for the real-video flow speed evaluation (eval/real_videos.py). The videos are not stored in git: the script downloads the originals into eval/videos/ (gitignored), checks each file's SHA-1 against the one Commons publishes, and cuts the segment below with ffmpeg (H.264, no audio, no metadata). Segments were chosen by looking at the footage before any run, for a camera that holds still and water with something on it, and were not changed after seeing results. Nobody measured the water speed in any of these videos, so there is no ground truth.
